test_case.test_name: AMD OOB UMC CRC-read replay-correctable EndToEndCrcErr CPER
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved CRC-read replay-correctable event produces the exact corrected EndToEndCrcErr CPER and ceases without escalation.
required_package: Authenticated Systems/UBB endpoint and CPER schema
Replay/deferred quiet-window oracle and GPU/BMC/host recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator captures CPER/counter/health baseline, validates target and CRC-read replay semantics, executes `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 0 -t 4 -a 0x800` once, attributes/hash-verifies/decodes the new CPER, validates UMC/ext15/EndToEndCrcErr/corrected fields, observes the approved quiet window for no continuing replay/deferred escalation, then verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: A unique CPER identifies the intended OAM/UMC with ext15 EndToEndCrcErr corrected severity; replay/deferred activity settles within the approved window and platform health remains good.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target/tool/replay identity, one command, unique corrected ext15 CPER, quiet-window compliance and recovery. HBMEcc/wrong subtype, continuing replay, fatal escalation, ambiguous artifact or instability fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Approved replay-correctable injection on dedicated idle GPU SUT.
Define replay/deferred quiet and recovery before execution.
Preserve full baseline with collision-safe entry attribution.
One command only; no automatic retry/reset.
expected_evidence: Single command and unique entry diff/hashes
test_case.recovery: On continuing replay/deferred error, escalation, wrong target or connectivity loss, preserve evidence and use approved OOB recovery only; never reissue automatically and verify all GPUs afterward.
